high.title: Markets Digest New Trump Tariffs; Ibovespa in Dollar Terms Falls Today (24)
high.summary: Global markets are absorbing the impact of new U.S. tariffs that took effect yesterday, targeting products from 60 countries including Brazil. The new tariff rates range between 10% and 12.5%, replacing the previous temporary global tariff of 10% that expired on Friday (July 24). According to the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR), the measures were triggered by investigations concluding that the targeted countries engaged in unfair trade practices related to forced labor.
